name: agents
description: Create, configure and delegate to other agents on this venue. Load when work should be done by a separate agent, or to manage existing agents.

content.inline:
## Agents
Create:
- create `{agentId, config}`. Config fields: `operation` (transition op, a PLAIN STRING like `v/ops/llmagent/chat`), `llmOperation`, `model`, `systemPrompt`, `tools` (FULL `v/ops/...` paths), `skills` (skill source refs), `context`, `caps`. Returns `created: false` if the id exists.
- Templates: pass `config: "v/agents/templates/<name>"` — minimal, reader, worker, analyst, manager, goaltree, full.
- update `{agentId, config}` merges changes; fork `{agentId, sourceId, config?}` copies an existing agent.

Delegate work:
- request `{agentId, input, sessionId?, wait?}` — a tracked task Job, async by default; await that Job for the result. With a `sessionId` the task runs IN that conversation — its turns join the session history (this is how deferred work reports back into a chat; your own current session shows as `Session:` in your context).
- chat `{agentId, message, sessionId?}` — conversational; a session is minted on first contact, pass `sessionId` to continue it.
- list / info `{agentId}` inspect; cancel-task `{agentId, taskId}` drops a queued task.

Rules:
- ALL settings live in top-level `config` — never inside `state`.
- `tools` entries must resolve as catalog paths or the agent silently lacks them (create warns).
- `v/ops/agent/trigger` is a wake-up kick, not a result-getter — submit real work via request or chat.
- Also available: message, suspend, resume, delete, context (inspection) under `v/ops/agent/`.
